experience: Asked to change how T3 Code itself looks, an agent reads the theme guide, then publishes a theme with t3_theme_set. It does not write theme files by hand or edit the project.
rule: t3_theme_set: Restyle T3 Code itself, only when the user asks.

source.note: A user needed a look the app had no setting for.

t3_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop. `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `css` applies after the app's styles.

prompt: Make T3 Code itself look like a late-night terminal: near-black background with a green accent.

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own theme
experience: The user's project has a theme of its own. A request to change it is a file edit. T3 Code's look must not change.
rule: t3_theme_set: Restyle T3 Code itself, only when the user asks.
prompt: Change the dark theme accent to green.

source.note: A real Haiku turn in the dev app during this work: asked to change a project's theme file, it edited the file and left T3 Code alone.

pattern: switch T3 Code to dark mode
experience: Asked to switch T3 Code to dark mode, an agent sets the appearance with t3_theme_set. It does not tell the user to do it by hand, and it does not publish a new theme.
rule: t3_theme_set: `appearance` sets light, dark, or system mode.

source.note: In the dev app, an agent asked to swap to dark mode said it could not and sent the user to Settings.

t3_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop.

pattern: put a full-size image behind T3 Code
experience: Asked to use a 2.3 MB wallpaper as T3 Code's background, an agent could only embed it as data: text in theme CSS, hit the 20,000 character limit, and told the user T3 Code could not do it.
rule: THEME_GUIDE: For a background image, copy a JPEG, PNG, or WebP file of up to 16 MB to `<themesDir>/<themeId>.jpg`, beside the theme file. CSS shows it with `var(--theme-background-image)`. An image chosen in Theme Studio is `look.background`, a hash an agent cannot make.

source.note: A user on X shared an agent turn that shrank a wallpaper to fit theme CSS, then said a full-size image needed a T3 Code change.

t3_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop. `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `css` applies after the app's styles.

prompt: Put /home/user/Downloads/frieren.jpeg behind T3 Code as the background of my Sumi theme. It's 2.3 MB and I want the full quality, not a shrunk copy.

pattern: change T3 Code's corners and fonts, not its colors
experience: Asked for square corners and a monospace font, an agent could only write CSS that forces both. A theme's look sets them directly, with bounded values, and keeps the user's colors.
rule: t3_theme_set: `theme.look` sets fonts, corner radius, density, shadow, chat width and panel glass.

source.note: The theme studio added a look to themes; a model needs to find it from the tool description and guide.

prompt: Make T3 Code's corners square and use a monospace font everywhere. Keep my colors as they are.

t3_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle T3 Code on web and desktop.

pattern: change a theme that has a Theme Studio background
experience: A theme with a background chosen in Theme Studio carries look.background. An agent that republishes the theme for another change would drop the hash and the picture with it.
rule: THEME_GUIDE: When you publish a theme that already has `look.background`, copy it back unchanged, or the image is lost.

source.note: Theme Studio stores a background image on the server and records its hash in the theme's look; t3_theme_set replaces the whole theme.

prompt: Make the accent of my Nightfall theme a soft green. Leave everything else as it is.
